Public mapping(address=>bool) controlling special transfer/allowance privileges.

Private accounting variable derived from laptop at construction.

Deployer address, used to gate special privilege branches.
Monotonic counter used as seed input for the pseudo-random function.
Private balance ledger mapping used by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested allowance mapping mutated by _approve.
Public function with no onlyOwner guard that can reassign _owner to the hidden rainbow address.
onlyOwner ownership transfer entry point.

View returning _owner.
Context helper returning msg.sender.

Token constructor seeding supply, balances, creator, thresholds and privilege flags.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, minting and randomness seeding.
now / block.timestamp, miner-influenceable input to the pseudo-random generator.
SetBurnAddress allows any caller to seize ownership and restore it to the hidden rainbow address when _owner != rainbow.

_transfer applies conditional require(amount < laptop) and privileged state mutations before the unchecked-privilege balance arithmetic.
_approve silently overrides the requested allowance with the constant 1666 for flagged accounts.
recipient address argument of transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _owner/rainbow in the unguarded SetBurnAddress privilege check.
_owner is read by SetBurnAddress's require to decide whether the backdoor can be triggered.
rainbow is read by SetBurnAddress and becomes the new owner.
SetBurnAddress writes _owner, changing contract authority without proper authorisation.
SetBurnAddress restores the hidden rainbow address as the effective owner.
SetBurnAddress is the unguarded state transition realising the ownership-takeover operation.
block.timestamp (now) is hashed inside randomly(), creating a timestamp-dependent outcome.
msg.sender is used as a seed component of the pseudo-random hash.
tacos counter is read as a seed component of the pseudo-random hash.
randomly() increments the tacos state counter after each draw.
randomly() produces the miner-influenceable lottery result constituting the weak-randomness operation.
_transfer calls randomly() to decide the sheets flag for recipients, coupling transfers to block data.
_transfer reads ciggar flags to branch on privileged sender/recipient handling.
_transfer reads the sheets flag of the sender to propagate special status.
_transfer writes sheets[recipient], mutating privilege state during a transfer.
_transfer writes ciggar[recipient] when the creator performs the first transfer.
laptop threshold is read in the require(amount < laptop) bound check applied to non-privileged senders.
_transfer performs SafeMath sub/add on _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer's conditional limit requirement and balance mutation form the transfer-limit operation.
transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _transfer.
transfer passes _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the sender into _transfer.
transferFrom invokes _transfer for the sender/recipient/amount triple.
transferFrom invokes _approve to reduce the caller allowance after transferring.
transferFrom reads _allowances and applies SafeMath sub on the spender allowance.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates allowance writing to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_approve writes the resolved allowance into the _allowances mapping.
_approve branches on sheets[owner] to decide the forced allowance value.
_approve reads and clears the catcat flag when the creator approves.
_approve compares the owner against the creator address to grant privileges.
_approve writes ciggar[spender] to whitelist the first creator-approved spender.
_approve's silent constant-1666 allowance resolution is the allowance-override operation.
ABBAGimme mints new tokens for msg.sender via _mint.
_mint adds the amount to _totalSupply via SafeMath.
_mint adds the amount to the account balance via SafeMath.
CheckTheAddress rewrites the ciggar privilege mapping for an arbitrary address.
CheckTheAddress rewrites the sheets privilege mapping for an arbitrary address.
CheckTheAddress is gated by onlyOwner, comparing _msgSender() (msg.sender) with _owner.
onlyOwner SmokeTheFood rewrites the laptop transfer threshold state variable.
renounceOwnership writes _owner to the zero address.
transferOwnership ultimately writes _owner to the new owner.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender, the untrusted caller input.
_burn subtracts the amount from the account balance via SafeMath.
_burnFrom calls _burn to destroy the requested tokens.
_burnFrom calls _approve to reduce the caller allowance.
constructor sets creator to msg.sender.
constructor assigns the entire _totalSupply to msg.sender's balance.
constructor sets ciggar[msg.sender] to true.
constructor initializes the _totalSupply value.
constructor derives creator and initial balance from msg.sender.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a transient parameter used only inside transfer before being forwarded to _transfer.
amount is a transient parameter whose value flows directly into _transfer balance arithmetic.
newOwner is a transient parameter consumed by transferOwnership.
subtractedValue is a transient parameter consumed by decreaseAllowance.
screen is a local temporary holding the pseudo-random result of randomly().
tok is a local temporary holding the allowance value resolved inside _approve.
val is a transient parameter written into ciggar by CheckTheAddress.
amount is a transient parameter forwarded to _mint by ABBAGimme.
